jobs.occupation: Car Painter wanted for fll time position
jobs.description:
Holdkraft is looking for skilled and motivated Car Painters to join a professional automotive workshop in Esbjerg. We are seeking candidates who take pride in delivering high-quality finishes and have experience within automotive painting and refinishing.

As a Car Painter, you will be responsible for preparing vehicles for painting, carrying out high-quality paintwork, and ensuring that every finished vehicle meets professional standards.

Your responsibilities:

• 
Preparing vehicles and surfaces for painting

• 
Masking, sanding and priming vehicle parts

• 
Mixing and applying paint according to specifications

• 
Polishing and finishing painted surfaces

• 
Performing quality inspections to ensure a flawless finish

• 
Maintaining a clean and safe working environment

We are looking for candidates who have:

• 
Previous experience as a Car Painter or relevant vocational qualifications

• 
Experience with automotive refinishing and spray painting

• 
Good attention to detail and commitment to quality

• 
Ability to work independently as well as part of a team

• 
English or Danish language skills

• 
A valid driving licence is considered an advantage

We offer:

• 
Full-time employment under a Danish contract

• 
Salary of 190–240 DKK per hour, depending on qualifications and experience

• 
Stable long-term employment with a reputable employer

• 
Immediate start for the right candidate

• 
A modern and professional working environment

• 
Support throughout the recruitment and onboarding process

• 
Assistance with practical matters related to starting work in Denmark

If you are an experienced Car Painter looking for a stable opportunity in Denmark, we would be happy to hear from you.

Apply by sending your CV to drift@holdkraft.dk or submit your application through www.holdkraft.dk.

jobs.occupation: Business Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Business Operations Coordinator søges

Vil du være med til at udvikle en voksende kæde af neglesaloner?

Vi søger en struktureret og forretningsorienteret Business Operations Coordinator, som kan hjælpe os med at optimere driften, forbedre økonomien og styrke kundeoplevelsen på tværs af vores saloner.

Du bliver en vigtig sparringspartner for ejeren og får stor indflydelse på virksomhedens udvikling.

• 
Analysere virksomhedens økonomi, nøgletal og KPI'er.

• 
Udarbejde ugentlige og månedlige rapporter til ejeren.

• 
Identificere muligheder for at reducere omkostninger og øge indtjeningen.

• 
Optimere arbejdsgange og implementere effektive processer.

• 
Sikre ensartet kvalitet og en høj kundeoplevelse på tværs af alle saloner.

• 
Bidrage til udvikling og styrkelse af virksomhedens brand.

• 
Følge op på salonenes performance og foreslå konkrete forbedringer.

• 
Samarbejde tæt med salonlederne for at sikre en effektiv og velfungerende drift.

Vi forventer, at du

• 
Har erfaring med drift, business operations eller projektledelse.

• 
Er stærk inden for analyse, talforståelse og rapportering.

• 
Arbejder struktureret og har et godt overblik.

• 
Er proaktiv, løsningsorienteret og ser muligheder frem for problemer.

• 
Har gode kommunikations- og samarbejdsevner.

• 
Behersker både dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale.

Vi tilbyder

• 
En spændende og alsidig stilling med stor indflydelse.

• 
Mulighed for at præge virksomhedens fortsatte udvikling.

• 
Tæt samarbejde med ejeren og korte beslutningsveje.

• 
Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med engagerede og dygtige kolleger.

• 
Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Ansøgningsfrist: Hurtigst muligt.

Vi indkalder relevante kandidater til samtale løbende og forbeholder os retten til at besætte stillingen, før ansøgningsfristen udløber.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

Business Operations Coordinator hiring

Are you passionate about improving business performance and helping a growing company succeed?

We are looking for a structured and business-oriented Business Operations Coordinator to help optimize our operations, improve financial performance, and enhance the customer experience across our nail salon locations.

You will work closely with the owner as a trusted business partner and play an important role in the company's continued growth and development.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Analyze the company's financial performance, key metrics, and KPIs.

• 
Prepare weekly and monthly management reports for the owner.

• 
Identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve profitability.

• 
Optimize workflows and implement efficient operational processes.

• 
Ensure consistent service quality and an excellent customer experience across all salon locations.

• 
Contribute to the development and strengthening of the company's brand.

• 
Monitor the performance of each salon and recommend practical improvements.

• 
Work closely with salon managers to ensure efficient day-to-day operations.

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

• 
Has experience in business operations, operations management, or project management.

• 
Possesses strong analytical, financial, and reporting skills.

• 
Is highly organized with excellent planning and coordination abilities.

• 
Is proactive, solution-oriented, and able to identify opportunities for improvement.

• 
Has excellent communication and collaboration skills.

• 
Is fluent in both Danish and English, spoken and written.

What We Offer

• 
An exciting and varied role with significant influence on the company's development.

• 
The opportunity to make a real impact in a growing business.

• 
Close collaboration with the owner and a fast decision-making environment.

• 
An informal and friendly workplace with dedicated colleagues.

• 
A competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.

Application Deadline: As soon as possible.

We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. Therefore, the position may be filled before the application deadline.

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.occupation: Lastbilchauffør søges til faste ture - Fredericia
jobs.description:
X max ApS søger lige nu dygtige lastbilchauffører til vores afdeling i Fredericia.

Som chauffør hos os får du en hverdag præget af faste ture med få stops. Du kender dine ruter, og vi prioriterer et roligt arbejdsmiljø uden stressende bytrafik eller konstante nye leveringsadresser. Det giver dig mulighed for at fokusere på sikker kørsel og overblik.

Du møder ind i Fredericia og kører ud på dine fastlagte ture. Arbejdstiden er fuldtid (5 dage om ugen) med ca. 10 timers effektiv arbejdstid om dagen, planlagt med fornuftige køreplaner og respekt for pauser.

 

Vi forventer, at du

• 
Har et gyldigt CE-kørekort.

• 
Har erfaring med kørsel med trækker og trailer.

• 
Kan kommunikere på enten dansk eller engelsk – både mundtligt og skriftligt (nødvendigt for sikkerhed og kundekontakt).

• 
Er ansvarsbevidst, punktlig og kan arbejde selvstændigt.

• 
Sætter pris på klare rammer, faste rutiner og et velorganiseret arbejde.

Vi tilbyder

• 
Høj løn – vi belønner din erfaring og indsats.

• 
Faste ture – du ved, hvad du skal, og hvor du skal hen.

• 
Få stops – ingen stressende jagt på mange små adresser.

• 
Udgangspunkt fra vores depot i Fredericia.

• 
Et stærkt team med fokus på trivsel, godt samarbejde og ordentlige forhold.

• 
Et internationalt miljø, hvor vi værdsætter mangfoldighed.

Ansøgning

Er du den stabile og erfarne chauffør, vi mangler i teamet i Fredericia? Så send din ansøgning og dit CV allerede i dag. Vi ser gerne ansøgninger på både dansk og engelsk.

Send din ansøgning til: xmax-online@outlook.com Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at ringe til os på 28 19 98 18.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

X max ApS is currently looking for skilled truck drivers for our department in Fredericia.

Base location at our depot in Fredericia

Application

jobs.occupation: Fertility Specialist
jobs.description:
Employment: Full-time or Part-time (3 days/week)
Start date: As soon as possible
International applicants from EU countries are encouraged to apply.

Join one of Denmark’s leading private fertility clinics

Sellmer Fertility Clinic is an established and highly specialised private fertility clinic located in the heart of Aarhus, Denmark. They provide evidence-based fertility treatment in a modern, patient-centred environment, helping individuals and couples realise their dream of becoming parents.

Due to continued growth and an increasing patient demand, they are looking for an experienced Fertility Specialist to join our clinical team.

Whether you are seeking a permanent position or a flexible part-time opportunity alongside your current role, we would like to hear from you.

The Opportunity

This is an exciting opportunity to become part of a highly skilled multidisciplinary team where quality of care, collaboration and professional development are central to everything we do.

Unlike many fertility clinics, our clinical setup allows for an excellent work-life balance:

• 
Flexible working arrangements and no work at the weekends.

• 
Modern private clinic with highly experienced teams

• 
Opportunity to influence clinical development

For candidates with the right experience and ambitions, there may also be the opportunity to develop into a Responsible Physician role in the future.

Your Responsibilities

As a Fertility Specialist, you will be responsible for delivering high-quality fertility care throughout the patient journey, including:

• 
Conducting consultations with IVF and IUI patients, including fertility assessments and evaluation of pregnancy potential.

• 
Planning and managing ovarian stimulation protocols for IVF and IUI treatment.

• 
Performing ultrasound examinations and follicular monitoring.

• 
Performing hysterosalpingo-contrast sonography (HyCoSy/HSU).

• 
Performing oocyte retrieval procedures.

• 
Performing embryo transfer procedures.

• 
Performing TESA procedures.

• 
Diagnosing and managing fertility-related conditions, including PCOS and endometriosis.

• 
Managing treatment-related complications, including infection, bleeding and ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome (OHSS).

• 
Managing egg donation programmes, including donor assessment and evaluation.

• 
Managing acute complications related to assisted reproductive treatment.

• 
Developing and maintaining clinical treatment protocols and guidelines.

• 
Interpreting laboratory results, including blood tests.

• 
Performing donor approval and donor work-up in accordance with applicable regulations.

• 
Contributing to the training, supervision and professional development of clinical staff.

Your Profile

We are looking for a physician who:

• 
Is a licensed medical specialist within Obstetrics & Gynaecology

• 
Has experience within reproductive medicine and assisted reproduction

• 
Is passionate about delivering outstanding patient care

• 
Works independently while contributing positively to a multidisciplinary team

• 
Enjoys a collaborative, quality-focused clinical environment

• 
Communicates confidently in English

Why Denmark?

Denmark is internationally recognised as one of the world’s leading countries within reproductive medicine and fertility treatment.

Living and working in Denmark offers:

• 
Excellent work-life balance

• 
High professional standards

• 
Modern healthcare system

• 
Safe society with a high quality of life

• 
International working environment

The clinic also offers help with providing accommodation for the days you’ll be working at the clinic.

Interested?

If you are an experienced Fertility Specialist looking for a rewarding opportunity in one of Scandinavia’s most respected private fertility clinics, we would be delighted to have a conversation with you.

You can send your application through the apply link below
